[boxed_warning] WARNING: FETAL TOXICITY See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning. When pregnancy is detected, discontinue lisinopril as soon as possible. ( 5.1 ) Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. [overdosage] 10 OVERDOSAGE Following a single oral dose of 20 g/kg no lethality occurred in rats, and death occurred in one of 20 mice receiving the same dose. The most likely manifestation of overdosage would be hypotension, for which the usual treatment would be intravenous infusion of normal saline solution. Lisinopril can be removed by hemodialysis [see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY ( 12.3 )] .

sources.text: Example: Desired dose: Lisinopril 10 mg orally BID (twice a day) On hand: Lisinopril 2.5 mg per 1 tablet How many tablets should the client receive per dose? D = Desired dose ( order ) = 10 mg H = Drug on hand ( what is available ) = 2.5 mg per 1 tablet Q = 1 tablet D = Desired dose ( order ) = 10 mg H = Drug on hand ( what is available ) = 2.5 mg per 1 tablet Q = 1 tablet 10 mg 2.5 mg × 1 tablet = 4 tablets 10 mg 2.5 mg × 1 tablet = 4 tablets 10 mg divided by 2.5 mg = 4 4 × 1 tablet = 4 tablets 10 mg divided by 2.5 mg = 4 4 × 1 tablet = 4 tablets The amount to be administered to the client is 4 tablets. Example: Ordered: Lisinopril 10 mg orally BID Available: Lisinopril 2.5 mg How many tablets should the client receive per dose?
